name: Barnard's Star
notes: Fastest-moving star in the sky: about 1.8 px north between Aug 2025 and Sep 2026, matching Gaia. Bright, so saturated.

name: ε Indi B
notes: Pair of brown dwarfs about 1 px of motion. ε Indi A sits 6.7′ away; widen to 15′ to see it.

name: WISE 0855−0714
notes: Coldest known brown dwarf. Invisible below 3.5 µm; look in the D5/D6 stacks. Moves about 2 px west.

name: RW Aur
notes: Young variable star. No motion; watch its brightness change.

name: R Dra
notes: Mira variable with a 246-day period. No motion; brightness follows the pulsation phase.
